t: Philip the Good,即勃艮第公爵,建立了"金羊毛骑士团",是世界上最有名望,排他,…
te: Philip the Good, the Duke of Burgundy, establishes the Order of the Golden Fleece, the most prestigious, exclusive, and…
dz: Philip the Good,即勃艮第公爵,建立了"金羊毛骑士团",是世界上最有名望,排他,最昂贵的骑士勋章.
de: Philip the Good, the Duke of Burgundy, establishes the Order of the Golden Fleece, the most prestigious, exclusive, and expensive order of chivalry in the world.

t: 穆拉德二世统治下的奥斯曼帝国从威尼斯共和国手中夺取了特萨洛尼察.
te: The Ottoman Empire under Murad II captures Thessalonica from the Republic of Venice.
dz: 穆拉德二世统治下的奥斯曼帝国从威尼斯共和国手中夺取了特萨洛尼察.
de: The Ottoman Empire under Murad II captures Thessalonica from the Republic of Venice.

t: 圣女贞德被布尔贡德派的军队所俘获于康比耶涅之围.
te: Joan of Arc is captured at the Siege of Compiègne by troops from the Burgundian faction.
dz: 圣女贞德被布尔贡德派的军队所俘获于康比耶涅之围.
de: Joan of Arc is captured at the Siege of Compiègne by troops from the Burgundian faction.

t: 五月被勃艮第人俘获的圣女贞德，被移交给博韦主教皮埃尔·科雄。
te: Joan of Arc, taken by the Burgundians in May, is handed over to Pierre Cauchon, the bishop of Beauvais.
dz: 五月被勃艮第人俘获的圣女贞德，被移交给博韦主教皮埃尔·科雄。
de: Joan of Arc, taken by the Burgundians in May, is handed over to Pierre Cauchon, the bishop of Beauvais.

t: 米兰领主弗朗切斯科·斯福尔扎征服了卢克卡.
te: Francesco Sforza, lord of Milan, conquers Lucca.
dz: 米兰领主弗朗切斯科·斯福尔扎征服了卢克卡.
de: Francesco Sforza, lord of Milan, conquers Lucca.
